title: KWT Rc7 [GUI V1]
script:
local TEXTURE_ID = "rbxassetid://73053804512950"
local SOUND_ID = "rbxassetid://1840712882"
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "KWT_Rc7 GUI"
screenGui.Parent = playerGui
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0,300,0,300)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-150,0.5,-150)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Parent = screenGui
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,50)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
title.Text = "KWT_Rc7 GUI"
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20,20,20)
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
title.TextScaled = true
title.BorderSizePixel = 0
title.Parent = frame
local button1 = Instance.new("TextButton")
button1.Size = UDim2.new(0,200,0,60)
button1.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-100,0,70)
button1.Text = "Sad_Rc7"
button1.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,146,79)
button1.TextScaled = true
button1.Parent = frame
local button2 = Instance.new("TextButton")
button2.Size = UDim2.new(0,200,0,60)
button2.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-100,0,150)
button2.Text = "Sky box"
button2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,150,70)
button2.TextScaled = true
button2.Parent = frame
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local dragging = false
local dragInput
local dragStart
local startPos
local function update(input)
	local delta = input.Position - dragStart
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale,startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,startPos.Y.Scale,startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end
frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = frame.Position
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)
frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		update(input)
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		update(input)
	end
end)
local function applySadMap()
	for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then
			for _, c in ipairs(v:GetChildren()) do
				if c:IsA("Decal") or c:IsA("Texture") then
					c:Destroy()
				end
			end
			v.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
			v.Transparency = 0
			v.Anchored = false
			for _, face in ipairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do
				local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
				decal.Texture = TEXTURE_ID
				decal.Face = face
				decal.Parent = v
			end
		end
	end
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	local oldSky = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
	if oldSky then oldSky:Destroy() end
	local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
	sky.SkyboxBk = TEXTURE_ID
	sky.SkyboxDn = TEXTURE_ID
	sky.SkyboxFt = TEXTURE_ID
	sky.SkyboxLf = TEXTURE_ID
	sky.SkyboxRt = TEXTURE_ID
	sky.SkyboxUp = TEXTURE_ID
	sky.Parent = Lighting
	Lighting.TimeOfDay = "12:00:00"
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.SoundId = SOUND_ID
	sound.Looped = true
	sound.Volume = 1
	sound.Parent = workspace
	sound:Play()
end
local function applySkyBox()
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	local userId = Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync("Me906906")
	local img = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(userId, Enum.ThumbnailType.AvatarBust, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
	for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then
			for _, face in ipairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do
				local decal = Instance.new("Texture")
				decal.Texture = img
				decal.Face = face
				decal.Parent = v
			end
		end
	end
	local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky") or Instance.new("Sky", Lighting)
	sky.SkyboxBk = img
	sky.SkyboxDn = img
	sky.SkyboxFt = img
	sky.SkyboxLf = img
	sky.SkyboxRt = img
	sky.SkyboxUp = img
end
button1.Activated:Connect(applySadMap)
button2.Activated:Connect(applySkyBox)
